literal_meaning: খাপে বসানো (তলোয়ারের খাপের মতো, রাগ সংবরণ করা অবস্থা)
figurative_meaning_en: Angry, in a state of rage
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আমার কথায় খুব খাপ্পা হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He got very khappa (angry) at my words.
The boss left in a khappa (furious) mood.
note: Derived from 'খাপ' meaning sheath, implying contained but ready-to-burst anger like a sword in its sheath.
